title: RTPS / ServicePlus Bihar – Certificates and Government Services
vacancyDetails: Online Bihar services including caste, income, residence certificates and many other citizen services.
qualification: Bihar residents and applicants eligible for the selected government service.
ageLimit: As per the selected service rules.
applicationFee: As per the selected service and official portal instructions.
selectionProcess: Online application -> Office verification -> Certificate or service delivery
documentsRequired: Aadhaar or identity proof, Bihar residence details and service-specific documents.
howToApply: Open Bihar ServicePlus / RTPS, select the required service, register or login, upload documents and track the application status.
shortDescription: Bihar RTPS / ServicePlus portal for caste, income, residence certificates and other government services.
content:
Bihar ServicePlus / RTPS provides online access to caste, income, residence certificates and many other citizen services.

Use the separate buttons below for registration, application status, certificate download, eligibility and each certificate service.

Select the required service and check its document, fee and verification requirements before submitting an application.
